milestone.title: M21 Phase 1 closure: pin remaining default features + dep-audit tighten

intent.outcome: Every direct runtime dep in crates/mp/Cargo.toml has an explicit features= (or documented exception). Transitive count recorded before/after; optional gate tighten if pinning saves headroom. jsonschema stays dev-only oracle unless a follow-up removes it.

problem.description: M21 dependency diet shipped mini_schema (Phase 2) and set make dep-audit gate at <=150 transitive crates (today 137). Phase 1 explicitly called for pinning features on all direct deps; evidence notes 6 deps still use defaults: regex, serde_json, walkdir, include_dir, tempfile, mp-model. make dep-audit lists them on every run. M21 stretch goal was <=100 runtime transitive — not met; gate was relaxed to 150. Closing Phase 1 reduces surprise transitive pulls on upgrades and documents intentional feature sets.

in_scope: Pin regex: default-features=false, features=[std, unicode-perl] (verify mini_schema pattern + mp search)
Pin walkdir, tempfile, include_dir where meaningful feature flags exist; document if none
Re-run cargo test -p mp, make test-fixtures, make dep-audit after each pin
Record before/after transitive count in milestone evidence
Update M21 evidence / ARCHITECTURE.md dep-policy paragraph if gate or policy changes
Optional: tighten make dep-audit gate from 150 to 130 if count allows with margin
out_of_scope: Removing walkdir/tempfile/include_dir (marginal DIY — not worth risk)

open_questions.question: Tighten dep-audit gate from 150 to 130 after pinning?
open_questions.answer: Suggestion: only tighten if post-pin count is <=125, leaving 5-crate buffer; otherwise keep 150 until raul/mp further diet.
